knowledge:
- key_parameters: txGenomeVer=Genome assembly version (e.g., "mm10") used to automatically download TxDb if txTxdb is not provided ;; stBedFiles=Named list of BED files containing genomic features to plot ;; txTxdb=A TxDb object containing gene annotation information ;; headOrtail=Logical; if TRUE, includes the 1kb promoter and 1kb tail DNA regions on the 5' and 3' sides of the transcript ;; enableCI=Logical; if TRUE, plots the Confidence Interval for the guitar plot ;; pltTxType=Character vector specifying transcript types to plot, e.g., c("tx"), c("mrna"), or c("ncrna") ;; stGroupName=Character vector specifying names for the feature groups in the plot legend ;; miscOutFilePrefix=Prefix for the automatically saved PDF output file (set to NA to suppress or specify a string) ;; txPrimaryOnly=Logical; if TRUE, filters to primary transcripts only
- alternatives: None mentioned, but TxDb objects can be loaded from local SQLite files, GFF files, or downloaded from UCSC using getTxdb() ;; blocks(import(file)) can be used to read BED files into GRangesList instead of passing raw file paths
- when_to_use: Use when you want to visualize and compare the distribution of RNA-related genomic features (e.g., m6A peaks, RNA-binding protein binding sites) relative to transcript landmarks (5'UTR, CDS, 3'UTR) across different transcript types.
- pitfalls: Automatically downloading TxDb via txGenomeVer requires an active internet connection and is slow; building and reusing a guitarTxdb or txdb object locally is highly recommended ;; The toy datasets/coordinates provided with the package (e.g., mm10_toy.sqlite) are very small and must never be used for real data analysis

workflows.name: guitar_plot_from_bed
workflows.intent: Generate transcriptomic landmark-guided distribution plots of genomic features from BED files using a TxDb object.
input: stBedFiles (list of BED files containing genomic features)
txdb_file (SQLite file containing TxDb transcript annotations)
workflows.stages: 1. Load the TxDb annotation database ;; 2. Define the list of BED files ;; 3. Generate the Guitar plot using GuitarPlot with custom parameters
workflows.code:
stBedFiles <- list(system.file("extdata", "m6A_mm10_exomePeak_1000peaks_bed12.bed",
                   package="Guitar"),
                   system.file("extdata", "m6A_mm10_exomePeak_1000peaks_bed6.bed", 
                   package="Guitar"))
txdb_file <- system.file("extdata", "mm10_toy.sqlite", 
                         package="Guitar")
txdb <- loadDb(txdb_file)
GuitarPlot(txTxdb = txdb, 
            stBedFiles = stBedFiles,
            headOrtail = TRUE,
            enableCI = FALSE,
            mapFilterTranscript = TRUE,
            pltTxType =  c("mrna"),
            stGroupName = c("BED12","BED6"))

workflows.name: custom_guitar_coordinates_and_sampling
workflows.intent: Build reusable genome-projected transcriptomic landmark coordinates (Guitar coordinates) and sample points from genomic features.
input: stBedFiles (list of BED files containing genomic features)
txdb_file (SQLite file containing TxDb transcript annotations)
workflows.stages: 1. Load the TxDb annotation database ;; 2. Build a reusable guitarTxdb object using makeGuitarTxdb ;; 3. Import BED files as GRangesList ;; 4. Sample points along the features using samplePoints
workflows.code:
txdb_file <- system.file("extdata", "mm10_toy.sqlite", 
                         package="Guitar")
txdb <- loadDb(txdb_file)
guitarTxdb <- makeGuitarTxdb(txdb = txdb,
                             txAmblguity = 5,
                             txMrnaComponentProp = c(0.1,0.15,0.6,0.05,0.1),
                             txLncrnaComponentProp = c(0.2,0.6,0.2),
                             pltTxType = c("tx","mrna","ncrna"),
                             txPrimaryOnly = FALSE)
stBedFiles <- list(system.file("extdata", "m6A_mm10_exomePeak_1000peaks_bed12.bed",
                   package="Guitar"),
                   system.file("extdata", "m6A_mm10_exomePeak_1000peaks_bed6.bed", 
                   package="Guitar"))
stGRangeLists = vector("list", length(stBedFiles))
sitesPoints <- list()
 for (i in seq_len(length(stBedFiles))) {
      stGRangeLists[[i]] <-  blocks(import(stBedFiles[[i]]))
    }
    for (i in seq_len(length(stGRangeLists))) {
      sitesPoints[[i]] <- samplePoints(stGRangeLists[i], 
                                  stSampleNum = 10,
                                  stAmblguity = 5,
                                  pltTxType =  c("mrna"), 
                                  stSampleModle = "Equidistance", 
                                  mapFilterTranscript = FALSE,
                                  guitarTxdb = guitarTxdb)
    }
